questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code queries the database while building the review? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
A member has successful logins only from 120 days ago, plus a failed login yesterday. How is the entry marked?
choices: stale: true, lastLogin is 120 days ago
stale: false, lastLogin is 120 days ago

questions.prompt: A user belongs to two orgs and holds an admin role only in the other org. Does that role show up in this org's review?
choices: Yes, roles are global per user
Yes, but only if the user is active
No, but their last login from the other org's sessions is also excluded
No, grantsForUsers filters by org_id; last login is not org-scoped

questions.prompt: Why does quarterlyReview accept a `now` function in its constructor?
choices: So tests can fix the current time and check the stale cutoff deterministically
To convert login timestamps to the org's time zone
To avoid creating Date objects inside the loop for performance
Because Postgres returns timestamps relative to server time
